references.text: The mountain of the Lord refers to Sinai/Horeb, where God revealed himself to Moses
The mountain of the Lord as a holy place where the covenant was made
The description of the ark of the covenant being carried before the people
The Lord goes before the people to find camping places for them
God's promise to give his people rest (menucha)
The resting place (menucha) that God will give his people in the promised land
The ark of the covenant goes before the people to show the way across the Jordan
The ark of the covenant called 'the ark of the Lord of all the earth'
A prayer that the Lord and his ark of the covenant should rise up to their resting place
Zion as the Lord's resting place (menucha) forever
The final rest (katapausis) that God's people will enter, typologically linked to the rest Israel sought
